name: Doppelgänger: Dawn of the Inverted Souls
source:
After her sister Bertha's death, Lucia Nicol is struggling to follow her footsteps. 

She becomes a self-centered person who will do anything to replace Bertha's position in her family. Her actions made her schoolmates loathe and bully her, thus leading to an unexpected event. One by one, the schoolmates who once bullied her were now attacked, and suddenly she became the main suspect. After those events, she found out that she was able to see people who can’t be seen by “normal” people, and that she had the ability to uncover the dark, insane truth of an entity called “Doppelganger”. 

Her life is suddenly in danger, and the people she normally trusts suddenly doesn’t look so kind any more…

[From [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18947]Lemmasoft forums[/URL]]
translation:
姐姐贝尔塔去世后，露西亚·尼科尔苦苦挣扎着想要追随她的脚步。为了取代贝尔塔在家中的位置，她变得以自我为中心，什么都做得出来。她的行为招致同学的厌恶与欺凌，也因此引发了一场意想不到的事件。曾经欺负过她的同学开始一个接一个遭到袭击，露西亚也突然成了头号嫌疑人。

经历这些事件后，她发现自己能够看见“普通人”无法看见的人，还拥有揭开名为“Doppelgänger”的存在背后那黑暗而疯狂真相的能力。

她的生命突然陷入危险，而那些平时信任的人，也不再显得那么和善了……

[来自[URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18947]Lemma Soft论坛[/URL]]
